https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AdditionalProduc.label: Additional Product Classification Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AdditionalProduc.definition: A product classification for the product other than the Global Product Classification(GPC brick value).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AdditiveDetails.label: Additive Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AdditiveDetails.definition: A set of details about one of the additives within the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AllergenDetails.label: Allergen Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AllergenDetails.definition: Details of an allergen for a product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AuthenticityDeta.label: Authenticity Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AuthenticityDeta.definition: A set of details about covert or overt security features that may contribute to checking the authenticity of a product or product instance.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AwardPrizeDetail.label: Award Prize
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/AwardPrizeDetail.definition: Describes a prize or award won by a product or organization.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Brand.label: Brand
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Brand.definition: Information on brands and sub-brands for a product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/CertificationDet.label: Certification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/CertificationDet.definition: Certification issued by a certifying body to a certification subject (Organization, Place, Product).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Clothing.label: Clothing
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Clothing.definition: A product that is worn on the body.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ColourCodeDetail.label: Colour Code Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ColourCodeDetail.definition: A set of colour code details (colour code, party controlling the code list) for the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/CompulsoryAdditi.label: Compulsory Additional Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/CompulsoryAdditi.definition: The group of compulsory information about a product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ContactPoint.label: Contact
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ContactPoint.definition: Information on an individual or department acting as point of contact for an organiation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Country.label: Country
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Country.definition: Country is a complex data type that indicates a country and a country subdivision.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/DietTypeCodeDeta.label: Diet Type Code Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/DietTypeCodeDeta.definition: A set of diet type code details (diet type code and diet type sub code) for the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Discount.label: Discount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Discount.definition: Provides information on a discount applicable to an offer for example 2 percent.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodAndBeverageP.label: Food and Beverage Preparation Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodAndBeverageP.definition: Food and Beverage Preparation Information is a complex data type that indicates a preparation state code and preparation instructions.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodBeverageToba.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodBeverageToba.definition: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient is a complex data type that includes an ingredient statement and details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodBeverageToba.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FoodBeverageToba.definition: A food, beverage or tobacco product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Footwear.label: Footwear
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Footwear.definition: Outerwear that is worn on the feet such as shoes or boots.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FruitsVegetables.label: Fruits and Vegetables
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/FruitsVegetables.definition: Contains properties related specifically to fruit and vegetable products.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/GeoCoordinates.label: GeoCoordinates
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/GeoCoordinates.definition: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/GeoShape.label: GeoShape
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/GeoShape.definition: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/LocationID_Detai.label: Location ID Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/LocationID_Detai.definition: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to locations. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions between identifiers. This class provides a mechanism for connecting and sharing location identifiers.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/LocationStatusHi.label: Location Status History
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/LocationStatusHi.definition: Over the lifetime of a location, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:LocationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Message.label: Message
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Message.definition: Any kind of electronic message for communication of information from one party to one or more other parties.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/MilkButterCreamY.label: Milk Butter Cream Yogurt Cheese Eggs Substitutes
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/MilkButterCreamY.definition: Milk butter cream yogurts cheese eggs and any substitutes for these products.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/NutritionMeasure.label: Nutrition Measurement Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/NutritionMeasure.definition: A class providing nutritional value and intake percent.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Offer.label: Offer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Offer.definition: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service,for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganicClaimDeta.label: Organic Claim Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganicClaimDeta.definition: A set of organic claim details for the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Organization.label: Organization
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Organization.definition: An Organization is any legal or physical entity involved at any point in any supply chain and upon which there is a need to retrieve predefined information. An Organization is uniquely identified by a Global Location Number (GLN).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationClas.label: Organization Classification Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationClas.definition: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties have developed taxonomies that classify business sectors, activities, and other organisational classifications. This class provides a A repeatable grouping of classification details for an organisation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationID_D.label: Organisation ID Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationID_D.definition: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to legal entities and/or functions. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions between identifiers. This class provides a mechanism for connecting and sharing party identifiers.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationStat.label: Organisation Status History
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/OrganizationStat.definition: Over the lifetime of an organisation, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:OrganizationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PackagingDetails.label: Packaging
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PackagingDetails.definition: Details on packaging for a product for example packaging type (bottle), materials, features, recycling, etc..

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PackagingMateria.label: Packaging Material Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PackagingMateria.definition: Information on any material used for packaging.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Place.label: Place
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Place.definition: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical location.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PostalAddress.label: Address
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PostalAddress.definition: The location at which a particular organization or person may be found or reached.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PriceSpecificati.label: Price Specification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/PriceSpecificati.definition: A structured value representing a monetary amount, consisting of a value and currency code.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Product.label: Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Product.definition: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ProductYieldDeta.label: Product Yield Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ProductYieldDeta.definition: A grouping of properties related to the yield of a food or beverage product according to a specified type of preparation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/QuantitativeValu.label: Measurement Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/QuantitativeValu.definition: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes. A unit of measurement is also specified.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ReferencedFileDe.label: Referenced File
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ReferencedFileDe.definition: Provides URL and other information on a referenced electronic file.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryIdenti.label: Regulatory Identifier
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryIdenti.definition: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that reference one document, record or dataset within one regulatory information system, repository or registry

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryInform.label: Regulatory Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryInform.definition: Information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryNotifi.label: Regulatory Notification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/RegulatoryNotifi.definition: A notification message about information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ReturnablePackag.label: Returnable Package Deposit Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ReturnablePackag.definition: Details of the deposit for returnable packaging for a product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Seafood.label: Seafood
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Seafood.definition: Seafood Products including fish and shellfish.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/SizeCodeDetails.label: Size Code Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/SizeCodeDetails.definition: A grouping of properties related to the representing the size of a product, by specifying a value from a specified code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/SizeDetails.label: Size Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/SizeDetails.definition: A grouping of properties related to the size of a wearable product

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/TargetMarketDeta.label: Target Market Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/TargetMarketDeta.definition: A set of target market details (product release date and associated countries) for the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/TextileMaterialD.label: Textile Material
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/TextileMaterialD.definition: Details on the composition of any materials used to make a product using textiles.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Transaction.label: Transaction
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/Transaction.definition: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that identify a business transaction ID and its type

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/WarrantyPromise.label: Warranty
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/WarrantyPromise.definition: An assurance that the product is reliable and that repairs or replacement will be done free of charge within a given time limit and under certain conditions in the event of a defect.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/WearableProduct.label: Wearable Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/WearableProduct.definition: Products that are worn on the body.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/acceptedPaymentM.label: Accepted Payment Method
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/acceptedPaymentM.definition: Code indicating a means of payment, for example, BANK_CHEQUE, CASH, etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/activityIdeas.label: Activity Ideas
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/activityIdeas.definition: A link to ideas for using a product or engaging in other forms of entertainment, particularly with children.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalLocati.label: Has Additional Location ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalLocati.definition: Location identifiers assigned and managed by government bodies, trade organisations, and other entities.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalOrgani.label: Has Additional Organization ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalOrgani.definition: Party/organisation identifiers assigned and managed by government bodies, trade organisations, and other entities.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.label: Has Additional Product Classification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.definition: Relates to a set of additional product classification details

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additive.label: Has Additive
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additive.definition: Relates to details about any additives that a product may contain.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additiveLevelOfC.label: Additive Level Of Containment
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additiveLevelOfC.definition: Code indicating the level of presence of the additive.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/address.label: Has Postal Address
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/address.definition: The postal address for an organization or place.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressCountry.label: Address Country
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressCountry.definition: Code specifying the country (and country subdivision) for the address using ISO 3166-1.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/affiliatedTo.label: Affiliated to
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/affiliatedTo.definition: Method for associating an organisation/party affiliated to the identified organisation e.g., when engaged in an agent relationship (insurance, shipping, etc).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/afterHoursContac.label: Has After Hours Contact
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/afterHoursContac.definition: Links to after-hours contact information. For general contact details, gs1:contactPoint SHALL be used.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenInfo.label: Allergen information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenInfo.definition: A link to a description of the allergen information.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenLevelOfC.label: Allergen Level Of Containment
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenLevelOfC.definition: Code specifying the level of presence of the allergen.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenType.label: Allergen Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenType.definition: Code specifying the type of allergen.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/anatomicalForm.label: Anatomical Form
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/anatomicalForm.definition: Describes the meat product in terms of whether it is the whole animal or part of the animal which has been cut such as the muscle, bone, organ, or fat.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/appDownload.label: App download
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/appDownload.definition: A link to a related mobile app

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableProduc.label: Applicable Products
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableProduc.definition: The set of product identifiers for which this regulatory notification message applies.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableTransa.label: Applicable Transactions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableTransa.definition: References one or more business transactions

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/audioFile.label: Has Audio File
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/audioFile.definition: Link to a file containing an audio clip which is relevant to the product. Examples are commercials, or instructional/ how to use audio files.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticity.label: Has Authenticity Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticity.definition: Links to details of covert/overt security markings that may be used to check authenticity of a product instance.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.label: Authenticity Security Feature Instructions Link
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.definition: Links to online instructions about how to locate a physical security marking and read a value from it.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.label: Authenticity Security Feature Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.definition: Links to a URI code value indicating a particular type of physical security marking.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availableAtOrFro.label: Available At/From
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availableAtOrFro.definition: The location the offered product or service is available from.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrize.label: Has Award Prize
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrize.definition: An award or prize given to the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeCountr.label: Award Prize Country Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeCountr.definition: An ISO standard code identifying the country in which a prize or award is given. It is recommended to populate this property with an ISO 3166-1 country code.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/backgroundInfo.label: Background Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/backgroundInfo.definition: A link to information typically from the owner of the identified entity about the creative background, thought leadership or influence of the identified entity. This may include the inspiration, innovation for a development process, literary approach or, the science or technology used.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/baseLocation.label: Base Location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/baseLocation.definition: A fixed physical location where a mobile location most commonly resides. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:baseLocationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/bestBeforeDate.label: Best Before Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/bestBeforeDate.definition: Best before date on the label or package signifies the end of the period under which the product will retain specific quality attributes or claims even though the product may continue to retain positive quality attributes after this date. Best before date is primarily used for consumer information and may be a regulatory requirement.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/biotinPerNutrien.label: Biotin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/biotinPerNutrien.definition: Biotin Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/bonelessClaim.label: Boneless Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/bonelessClaim.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the product makes a specific claim to contain no bones.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brand.label: Has Brand
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brand.definition: The brand of the product that appears on the consumer package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandHomepageCli.label: Information for professionals about this brand
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandHomepageCli.definition: A link to a brand presence aimed at clinical professionals.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandHomepagePat.label: Information for patients about this brand
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandHomepagePat.definition: A link to a brand presence aimed at patients.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandOwner.label: Has Brand Owner
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandOwner.definition: The brand owner of the product. The organization that is responsible for allocating the GTIN to the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/businessEntity.label: Has Business Entity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/businessEntity.definition: Method for noting business structure (e.g., Limited liability company, not for profit). Expects a repeatable value from gs1:BusinessEntityType code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/calciumPerNutrie.label: Calcium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/calciumPerNutrie.definition: Calcium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/carbohydratesPer.label: Carbohydrates Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/carbohydratesPer.definition: Carbohydrates per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/careersInfo.label: Careers information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/careersInfo.definition: A link to information about jobs, careers, or other employment opportunities associated to an organisation or location.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certification.label: Has Certification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certification.definition: Certification information about a product, organisation or location.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAge.label: Certification Agency URL
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAge.definition: URL of the organisation issuing the certification standard or other requirement being met. e.g. https://www.msc.org , https://www.fsc.org

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.label: Certification Status
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.definition: Indicates the current status of the certification, e.g. active or inactive.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSub.label: Certification Subject
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSub.definition: References the object (e.g. product, asset, container), party or location being certified. If multiple values are specified, the certification details apply to the logical conjunction (AND) of groups of different types, while a logical disjunction (OR) applies within each group of the same type. For example, two sibling organisations O1 and O2 can process products P1 and P2 at locations L1 and L2: meaning that either organisation can process either product at either location (OR); but the certificate holds for the combinations of organisation (either O1 OR O2) AND product (either P1 OR P2) AND location (either L1 OR L2)

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cheeseFirmness.label: Cheese Firmness
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cheeseFirmness.definition: The firmness of the cheese product for example EXTRA_HARD.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/chloridePerNutri.label: Chloride Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/chloridePerNutri.definition: Chloride per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cholesterolPerNu.label: Cholesterol Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cholesterolPerNu.definition: Cholesterol per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/chromiumPerNutri.label: Chromium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/chromiumPerNutri.definition: Chromium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCode.label: Has Colour Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCode.definition: Relates to a set of details about the colour code for a product

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCodeList.label: Colour Code List
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCodeList.definition: The parties controlling the colour code lists. Dependent on colour code value.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.label: Compulsory Additional Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.definition: The legally required/compulsory additional label information as stated on the product packaging or label.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.label: Compulsory Additional Label Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.definition: The legally required/compulsory additional label information as stated on the product packaging or label.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.label: Compulsory Additional Label Information Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/compulsoryAdditi.definition: The code indicating the type of the legally required/compulsory additional information that is stated on the product packaging label.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerHandling.label: Has Consumer Handling Storage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerHandling.definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the manufacturer's recommendations for how the consumer or end user should store and handle the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerHandling.label: Consumer handling and storage information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerHandling.definition: A link to information about safe handling and storage for consumer use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerLifestag.label: Consumer Lifestage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerLifestag.definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the period or stage in the consumer's life during which the product is considered to be suitable.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerProductV.label: Consumer Product Variant
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerProductV.definition: The consumer product variant may be used to distinguish one variant of a retail consumer trade item from another if the change does not require the allocation of a different Global Trade Item Number (per the GTIN Management Standard), but communication between trading partners is required to support consumers. The brand owner is responsible for assigning the consumer product variant.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerSalesCon.label: Consumer Sales Condition Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerSalesCon.definition: A code indicating restrictions imposed on the product regarding how it can be sold to the consumer for example Prescription Required.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactPoint.label: Has Business Contact
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactPoint.definition: Contact information. To specify a contact specifically designated for after-hours support, see gs1:afterHoursContact

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactRoleCode.label: Has Contact Role Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactRoleCode.definition: The function or role of a contact. Value from gs1:ContactRoleType code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containedInPlace.label: Contained in Place
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containedInPlace.definition: Designates the larger physical location a sub-location is located within. To specify sub-locations of a physical location, see gs1:containsPlace.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containsPlace.label: Contains Place
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containsPlace.definition: Designates a sub-location (e.g., floor, room, shelf) within the physical location being identified. There may be multiple sub-locations associated to a single, physical location. To specify the larger physical location the sub-location is located within, see gs1:containedInPlace

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/copperPerNutrien.label: Copper Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/copperPerNutrien.definition: Copper per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfAssembl.label: Has Country Of Assembly
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfAssembl.definition: The place where product is assembled.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfLastPro.label: Has Country Of Last Processing
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfLastPro.definition: The place where the product or ingredient was last processed and tested before importation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfOrigin.label: Has Country Of Origin
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfOrigin.definition: Code indicating the country of origin of the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/customerSupportC.label: Has Customer Support Centre
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/customerSupportC.definition: The organization which provides product support to the trading partner organization to which merchandise is sold.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/defaultLink.label: Default link
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/defaultLink.definition: The default link for a given identified item to which a resolver will redirect unless there is information in the request that is a better match.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/defaultLinkMulti.label: Default linkMulti
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/defaultLinkMulti.definition: A set of 'default links' that may be differentiated by information in the HTTP request headers sent to a resolver to enable a better match than the single default link.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dependentProprie.label: Has Dependent Proprietary Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dependentProprie.definition: Dependent products are products which are required to make the current product functional.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietType.label: Diet Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietType.definition: Code indicating the diet the product is suitable for example Kosher.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dpp.label: Digital Product Passport
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dpp.definition: A link to a digital product passport.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/drainedWeight.label: Drained Weight
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/drainedWeight.definition: The weight of the product when drained of its liquid. For example 225 GRM, Jar of pickles in vinegar.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dueDate.label: Due Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dueDate.definition: The date by which an invoice should be paid. This data element represents an attribute of a payment slip reference number, AI (8020), and a Global Location Number (GLN) of the invoicing party.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/durationOfWarran.label: Duration Of Warranty
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/durationOfWarran.definition: The time period that the warranty is valid within.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eifu.label: Electronic Instructions For Use
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eifu.definition: A link to electronic Instruction For Use instructions for Medical Devices.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.label: Eligible Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.definition: The quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid. If this is not specified, an eligible quantity of 1 should be assumed.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.label: Eligible Quantity Maximum
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.definition: The maximum quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.label: Eligible Quantity Minimum
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleQuantity.definition: The minimum quantity including unit of measure for which the offer for good or service is valid.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/energyFromFatPer.label: Energy from Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/energyFromFatPer.definition: Energy from Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/energyPerNutrien.label: Energy Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/energyPerNutrien.definition: Energy Per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epcis.label: EPC Information Services (EPCIS) repository
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epcis.definition: A link to an EPCIS repository of visibility event data.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epcisRepository.label: EPC Information Services (EPCIS) repository
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epcisRepository.definition: A link to an EPCIS repository of visibility event data.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epil.label: Electronic Patient Information Leaflet
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/epil.definition: A link to an electronic patient information leaflet.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/equivalentProduc.label: Has Equivalent Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/equivalentProduc.definition: A product which can be substituted for the product based on supplier-defined functional equivalence to the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eventsInfo.label: Events information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eventsInfo.definition: A link to event details. For a page specifically for scheduling a reservation or booking an appointment, see gs1:scheduleTime.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exclusionDescrip.label: Exclusion Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exclusionDescrip.definition: A text description of any products, brands, or categories that cannot be used with the offer

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/expirationDate.label: Expiration Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/expirationDate.definition: The expiration date is the date that determines the limit of consumption or use of a product/coupon. Its meaning is determined based on the trade item context (e.g., for food, the date will indicate the possibility of a direct health risk resulting from use of the product after the date, for pharmaceutical products, it will indicate the possibility of an indirect health risk resulting from the ineffectiveness of the product after the date). It is often referred to as 'use by date' or 'maximum durability date'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/expirationDateTi.label: Expiration Date and Time
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/expirationDateTi.definition: The manufacturer determines the expiration date and time, which is relevant only for short duration and for items that will not be sent on long distances and not outside of the time zone. A typical application of AI (7003) is in hospitals or public pharmacies for special, customised, products which may have a 'life duration' shorter than one single day. The life duration varies according the pharmaceutical substances used in the treatment. The precise expiration date and time is defined at the end of the manufacturing process, and can be barcoded on the product label as an attribute to the item's GTIN. Where there is no business requirement to express the expiration date to the nearest hour (or less), AI (17) Expiration date should be used.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/faqs.label: Frequently Asked Questions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/faqs.definition: A link to a set of frequently asked questions.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatPerNutrientBa.label: Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatPerNutrientBa.definition: Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fibrePerNutrient.label: Fibre Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fibrePerNutrient.definition: Fibre per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/firstFreezeDate.label: First Freeze Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/firstFreezeDate.definition: The first freeze date is applicable to products that are frozen directly after slaughtering, harvesting, catching or after initial processing of the product. Examples include fresh meat, meat products or fishery products. The first freeze date is determined by the organisation conducting the freezing.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fluoridePerNutri.label: Fluoride Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fluoridePerNutri.definition: Fluoride per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/folicAcidPerNutr.label: Folic Acid Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/folicAcidPerNutr.definition: Folic Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/foodBeverageRefr.label: Food Beverage Refrigeration Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/foodBeverageRefr.definition: Identifies whether or not the product requires refrigeration.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/foodBeverageTarg.label: Food Beverage Target Use
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/foodBeverageTarg.definition: The type of meal the food or beverage product is targeted to for example Breakfast.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/footwearFastenin.label: Fastening Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/footwearFastenin.definition: Something that mechanically joins or affixes two or more parts together in a footwear product for example a shoe lace.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/footwearUpperTyp.label: Footwear Upper Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/footwearUpperTyp.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether the footwear upper is open or closed. Otherwise known as Open or Closed Upper.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/franchiseeOf.label: Franchisee of
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/franchiseeOf.definition: Method for associating the franchisor organisation to the franchisee.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/franchisorOf.label: Franchisor of
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/franchisorOf.definition: Method for associating franchisee organisation(s) to the franchisor.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/freshOrSeawaterF.label: Fresh or Seawater Farmed
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/freshOrSeawaterF.definition: A code determining whether the fish originated from the sea or was farmed.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/geneticallyModif.label: Genetically Modified Declaration Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/geneticallyModif.definition: A statement of the presence or absence of genetically modified protein or DNA.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/geo.label: Has Geocoordinates
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/geo.definition: Links to information about geocoordinates or geoshapes for a place.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/glnType.label: Has GLN Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/glnType.definition: Indicates what type of thing is being identified by a GLN.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossArea.label: Gross area
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossArea.definition: The overall area of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossVolume.label: Gross volume
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossVolume.definition: The overall volume of the item including packaging. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the volume is measured.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossWeight.label: Gross Weight
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/grossWeight.definition: Used to identify the gross weight of the product. The gross weight includes all packaging materials of the product. At pallet level the productGrossWeight includes the weight of the pallet itself. For example, 200 GRM, value - total pounds, total grams, etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/growingMethod.label: Growing Method
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/growingMethod.definition: The process through which fresh produce is grown and cultivated.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/handledBy.label: Handled by
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/handledBy.definition: Used when one resolver redirects all request URIs that match a given pattern without further processing, such as from GS1 to a brand-operated service. See section 7.7.1 of the Digital Link standard, version 1.1.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDate.label: Harvest Date.
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDate.definition: The harvest date. For example, the harvest date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDateEnd.label: Harvest Date End
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDateEnd.definition: The harvest end date. For example, the harvest end date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This end date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDateStart.label: Harvest Date Start
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/harvestDateStart.definition: The harvest start date. For example, the harvest start date can be the date when an animal was slaughtered or killed, a fish has been harvested, or a crop was harvested. This start date is determined by the organisation conducting the harvesting. Different organisations may use more specific terminology when referring to their specific needs and use terms such as: Date of catch or slaughter date. When referring to animals the date range refers to the whole animal and all meat or fish cuts derived from this animal.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasBatchLotNumbe.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasBatchLotNumbe.definition: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasPrimaryLocati.label: Has primary location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasPrimaryLocati.definition: Links to the place(s) that this organisation designates as their primary location(s).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasRetailers.label: Has Retailers
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasRetailers.definition: A link to a list of retailers.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasReturnablePac.label: Has Returnable Package Deposit Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasReturnablePac.definition: links to details of amounts refunded for returnable package in a specified region.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasSerialNumber.label: Serial Number
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasSerialNumber.definition: A serial number is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a serial number uniquely identifies an individual item. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of serial numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of serial numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasThirdPartyCon.label: Third-Party Controlled Serial Number
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/hasThirdPartyCon.definition: This identifier is assigned to an entity for its lifetime. When combined with a GTIN, a TPX uniquely identifies an individual item and forms a unit pack Unique Identifier (upUI) for tobacco traceability per EU 2018/574. The serial number field is alphanumeric and may include all characters contained in figure 7.11-1. The Third Party determines the TPX, but the TPX shall begin with the ID Issuer Unique Identification Code (UIC), followed by GS1 UIC Extension 1, and GS1 UIC Extension 2.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/homepage.label: Organisation Information Page
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/homepage.definition: A link to general information about an organisation or brand. Typically the homepage of an organisation's website. It may include links to further information such as certifications, careers, payments, reservations, etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/image.label: Has Product Image
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/image.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageDepth.label: In Package Depth
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageDepth.definition: The depth of the product in its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageDiamete.label: In Package Diameter
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageDiamete.definition: The measurement of the diameter of the product in its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageHeight.label: In Package Height
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageHeight.definition: The height of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageWidth.label: In Package Width
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/inPackageWidth.definition: The width of the product in the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredient.label: Has Food And Beverage Ingredient Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredient.definition: Links to information about ingredients of a specific Food/Beverage/Tobacco product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientsInfo.label: Ingredients information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientsInfo.definition: A link to facts about ingredients.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/instructions.label: Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/instructions.definition: A link to instructions, such as assembly instructions, usage tips etc. It is not appropriate to use this link type for healthcare regulated content applications for which specific link types are available.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/instructionsForU.label: Has Instructions For Use
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/instructionsForU.definition: Link to a file containing the Instructions For Use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/iodinePerNutrien.label: Iodine Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/iodinePerNutrien.definition: Iodine per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ironPerNutrientB.label: Iron Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ironPerNutrientB.definition: Iron per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/irradiatedCode.label: Irradiated Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/irradiatedCode.definition: Indicates if radiation has been applied to the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isCarbonated.label: Is Carbonated
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isCarbonated.definition: Used to identify whether or not a beverage product is naturally effervescent or has been made effervescent by the addition of carbon dioxide gas.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isDecaffeinated.label: Is Decaffeinated
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isDecaffeinated.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product contains caffeine.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isFromConcentrat.label: Is From Concentrate
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isFromConcentrat.definition: Used to identify whether or not the product claims to be made from a concentrated formulation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isHomogenised.label: Is Homogenised
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isHomogenised.definition: A The indication whether or not the milk used was actively homogenised. The homogenisation of milk is a technical process in the dairy. The milk fat is milled to such an extent that further creaming is prevented.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isInstant.label: Is Instant
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isInstant.definition: Determines whether the product is instant.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isMaternity.label: Is Maternity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isMaternity.definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify if the product is intended as maternity wear.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPatterned.label: Is Patterned
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPatterned.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product has a patterned design.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPittedStoned.label: Is Pitted Stoned
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPittedStoned.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not a fruit or vegetable product has been de-stoned or pitted prior to being offered for sale.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isRindEdible.label: Is Rind Edible
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isRindEdible.definition: An indicator whether or not the cheese rind is edible. Some cheeses are coated in plastic or their surface is treated with other traditional substances to increase their shelf life. This can result in the rind no longer being edible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isSeedless.label: Is Seedless
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isSeedless.definition: Determines whether the product is seedless as grown.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isShelledPeeled.label: Is Shelled or Peeled
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isShelledPeeled.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify whether or not the product or its contents have been shelled/peeled prior to being offered for sale.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isSliced.label: Is Sliced
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isSliced.definition: Determines whether the product comes pre-sliced.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isThermal.label: Is Thermal
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isThermal.definition: The descriptive term that is used to identify whether the product is thermal.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isVintage.label: Is Vintage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isVintage.definition: Identifies whether the product makes claim to being vintage.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWashedReadyToE.label: Is Washed Ready To Eat
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWashedReadyToE.definition: Determines whether product has been prewashed and is ready to eat.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWaterproof.label: Is Waterproof
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWaterproof.definition: The descriptive term that is used to identify whether or not the product claims to provide waterproofing to the applied surface.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWearableItemDi.label: Is Wearable Item Disposable
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isWearableItemDi.definition: Identifies whether or not the product is intended to be disposed of after single use or a limited period of use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/itemOffered.label: Item Offered
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/itemOffered.definition: The product included in the offer.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/jws.label: JSON Web Signature
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/jws.definition: A link to a JSON Web Signature

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedFrom.label: Leased from
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedFrom.definition: Links to the organisation (lessor) from which this place is leased.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedTo.label: Leased to
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedTo.definition: Links to the organisation(s) (lessee(s)) to which this place is leased. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leaveReview.label: Leave a review
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leaveReview.definition: A link through which a review can be added.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/lesseeOf.label: Lessee of location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/lesseeOf.definition: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is the lessee (i.e., this organisation leases those places from another organisation, the lessor).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/lessorFor.label: Lessor for
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/lessorFor.definition: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is the lessor (i.e., this organisation leases those places to others).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/linkType.label: Link Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/linkType.definition: Provides a URL for related information or services. This is not expected to be used directly but provides a super property for all other link types in the GS1 ecosystem.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/location.label: Has Location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/location.definition: The place(s) associated with an organization.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationHistory.label: Has Location History
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationHistory.definition: Provides details on if and when a location is active or inactive.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_Type.label: Location ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_Type.definition: Organisation that administers the gs1:locationID or the name of the ID itself. Value from gs1:LocationID_Type code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_URI.label: Location ID URI
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_URI.definition: A URI that links to information about the gs1:locationID.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationInfo.label: Location information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationInfo.definition: A link to a map, directions, or other location-related information. For B2B location information, see gs1:logisticsInfo. For details specific to hours of operation, see gs1:openingHoursInfo

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationRole.label: Location Role
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationRole.definition: A location classification based on the purpose, type of site and/or what occurs there. Repeatable value from gs1:LocationRoleType code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationStatus.label: Location Status
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationStatus.definition: Designation of active/inactive status of a location.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/logisticsInfo.label: Logistics information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/logisticsInfo.definition: A link to B2B logistics information related to a physical location.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/loyaltyProgram.label: Loyalty program
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/loyaltyProgram.definition: A link to information about a loyalty program, including a member's current status and/or a registration option for new members

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/magnesiumPerNutr.label: Magnesium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/magnesiumPerNutr.definition: Magnesium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/makesOffer.label: Makes Offer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/makesOffer.definition: An offer made by an organization.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/managedBy.label: Managed by
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/managedBy.definition: Links to the organisation that manages this place or organisation, as designated by the owner or another organisation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/managedFor.label: Managed for
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/managedFor.definition: Links to the organisation(s) for whom this place is managed. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manages.label: Manages
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manages.definition: Links to the place(s) or organisation(s) that this organisation manages, on behalf of the owner or another organisation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manganesePerNutr.label: Manganese Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manganesePerNutr.definition: Manganese per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturer.label: Has Manufacturer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturer.definition: The organization that produces the item.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturerPrep.label: Manufacturer Preparation Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturerPrep.definition: Code indicating the preparation methods that a manufacturer has used in the manufacturing of a product for example DEEP_FRY.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturersWar.label: Has Manufacturer's Warranty
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturersWar.definition: The warranty associated with the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturingPla.label: Has Manufacturing Plant
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/manufacturingPla.definition: A physical location consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/massPerUnitArea.label: Mass per unit area
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/massPerUnitArea.definition: The mass per unit area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the mass and area are measured.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/masterData.label: Master data
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/masterData.definition: A link to a source of structured master data for the entity. This is typically for B2B applications.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/masterDataAvaila.label: Master Data Available For
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/masterDataAvaila.definition: Links from a document, message or event to static data for specified identifiers.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maturationMethod.label: Maturation Method Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maturationMethod.definition: The method of maturity for the item for example tree ripened or jet fresh.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumOptimumCo.label: Maximum Optimum Consumption Temperature
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumOptimumCo.definition: The upper limit drinking temperature of the optimum range of the drinking temperature. The optimum range of the drinking temperature is a recommendation and is based on the experience of the individual producer. Allows for the representation of the same value in different units of measure but not multiple values.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/menuInfo.label: Menu information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/menuInfo.definition: A link to menu details. This may include food menus, services, or other offerings provided by an organisation or at a location. For details specific to allergens only, see gs1:allergenInfo . For details specific to nutrition information only, see gs1:nutritionalInfo . For details specific to ingredients only, see gs1:ingredientsInfo .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/messageRecipient.label: Message Sender
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/messageRecipient.definition: Identifies the party receiving an electronic message

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/messageSender.label: Message Sender
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/messageSender.definition: Identifies the party sending an electronic message

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumFishConte.label: Minimum Fish Content
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumFishConte.definition: The minimum amount of fish contained in a food and beverage product expressed as a measurement.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumMeatPoult.label: Minimum Meat Poultry Content
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumMeatPoult.definition: The minimum amount of fish, meat or poultry contained in a food and beverage product expressed as a measurement.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumOptimumCo.label: Minimum Optimum Consumption Temperature
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumOptimumCo.definition: The lower limit drinking temperature of the optimum range of the drinking temperature. The optimum range of the drinking temperature is a recommendation and is based on the experience of the individual producer. Allows for the representation of the same value in different units of measure but not multiple values.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/molybdenumPerNut.label: Molybdenum Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/molybdenumPerNut.definition: Molybdenum per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/monounsaturatedF.label: Monounsaturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/monounsaturatedF.definition: Monounsaturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netArea.label: Net area
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netArea.definition: The net area of the item. This can be given using a number of different AI ranges that depend on the units in which the area is measured.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netContent.label: Net content
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netContent.definition: The quantity of the product contained by a package, usually as claimed on the label. Indicates the net content of the total product. For fixed value products use the value claimed on the package, to avoid variable fill rate issue that arises with some product which are sold by volume or weight, and whose actual content may vary slightly from batch to batch.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netWeight.label: Net weight
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/netWeight.definition: Used to identify the net weight of the product. Net Weight excludes all packaging material, including the packaging material of all lower-level GTINs. Example:11.5 kgm.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/niacinPerNutrien.label: Niacin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/niacinPerNutrien.definition: Niacin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.label: Number of Servings Per Package Measurement Precision
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.definition: Code indicating whether the number of servings per package is exact or approximate.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientBasisQua.label: Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientBasisQua.definition: Quantity on which the nutrient information has been based; for example, per 100 grams. When specified, nutrientBasisQuantity establishes the basis for all contained nutrient records.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientBasisQua.label: Nutrient Basis Quantity Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientBasisQua.definition: The type of quantity specified in the nutrientBasisQuantity for example measurement, serving size, or container. This is used in conjunction with the nutrientBasisQuantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientMeasurem.label: Nutrient Measurement Precision
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutrientMeasurem.definition: The Code indicating whether the specified nutrient content is exact or approximate.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutritionalClaim.label: Nutritional Claim Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutritionalClaim.definition: Code indicating a nutritional claim applicable to the product, for example FAT_FREE.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/occupiedBy.label: Occupied by
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/occupiedBy.definition: Links to the organisation(s) that occupy this place. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/occupies.label: Occupies location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/occupies.definition: Links to the place(s) that this organisation occupies.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDiscount.label: Offer Discount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDiscount.definition: A discount associated with an offer.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRedemptionU.label: Offer Redemption URL
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRedemptionU.definition: The URL where the offer seeker will need to go in order to redeem the offer for an online redemption.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/openingHoursInfo.label: Opening hours information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/openingHoursInfo.definition: A link to details on hours of operation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicClaim.label: Has Organic Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicClaim.definition: Relates to an organic claim about the product

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicClaimAgen.label: Organic Claim Agency Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicClaimAgen.definition: A governing body that creates and maintains standards related to organic products.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.label: Has Organization Classification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.definition: Links to one or more instances of gs1:OrganizationClassificationDetails for expresing the classification of the economic activities of an organisation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationHist.label: Has Organization History
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationHist.definition: Provides details on if and when an organisation/party is active or inactive.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_T.label: Organisation ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_T.definition: Organisation that administers the gs1:organizationID or the name of the ID itself. Value from gs1:OrganizationID_Type code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_U.label: Organisation ID URI
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_U.definition: A URI that links to information about the gs1:organizationID.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationRole.label: Has Organization Role
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationRole.definition: The role and/or purpose of a party (i.e. legal entity or function). Multiple values from gs1:OrganizationRoleType code list may be associated to a single organisation/party.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationStat.label: Organisation Status
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationStat.definition: Designation of active/inactive status of an organisation/party.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageDept.label: Out of Package Depth
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageDept.definition: The depth of the product out of its packaging, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageDiam.label: Out of Package Diameter
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageDiam.definition: The measurement of the diameter of the product out of its package at its largest point. For example, 165 MMT.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageHeig.label: Out of Package Height
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageHeig.definition: The height of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageWidt.label: Out of Package Width
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/outOfPackageWidt.definition: The width of the product out of the package, as measured according to the GS1 Package Measurement Rules. See https://www.gs1.org/package-measurement-rules-implementation-guide for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ownedBy.label: Owned by
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ownedBy.definition: Links to the organisation(s) that own this place, in full or in part. This includes joint ventures. For leased locations, see gs1:lessorFor and gs1:isLeasedFrom.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/owns.label: Owns
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/owns.definition: Links to the place(s) or organisation(s) that this organisation owns.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packaging.label: Has Packaging
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packaging.definition: Details on the packaging for a product including type, weight and materials.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingDate.label: Packaging Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingDate.definition: The packaging date is the date when the goods were packed as determined by the packager. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingFeature.label: Packaging Feature
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingFeature.definition: Code indicating a feature that facilitates the usage of the product by the consumer, for example a handle. Packaging features do not affect the core composition of the packaging type nor modify its usage.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingFunctio.label: Packaging Function
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingFunctio.definition: Code indicating specific functionality for packaging resulting from specific processes or features present in the packaging type,for example, ANTI_TAMPERING.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedD.label: Packaging Marked Diet Allergen Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedD.definition: Indication of which dietary or allergen marks are on the package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedF.label: Packaging Marked Free From Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedF.definition: Indication of the food ingredients that the package is marked free from.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedL.label: Accreditation Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMarkedL.definition: A marking that the product received recognition, endorsement, certification by following guidelines by the label issuing agency. This does not represent claims for regulatory purposes on products such as free from markings.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.label: Has Packaging Material Details
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.definition: links to details about packaging material type, quantity and thickness

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.label: Packaging Material Composition Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.definition: The quantity of the packaging material of the product. Can be weight, volume or surface, can vary by country.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.label: Packaging Material Thickness
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.definition: The thickness of a packaging material.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.label: Packaging Material Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingMateria.definition: The materials used for the packaging of the product for example glass or plastic.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingRecycli.label: Packaging Recycling Process Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingRecycli.definition: The process the packaging could undertake for recyclable & sustainability programs. Examples COMPOSTABLE, ENERGY_RECOVERABLE, REUSABLE.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingRecycli.label: Packaging Recycling Scheme
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingRecycli.definition: A code indicating the recycling scheme the packaging of this product will fall within when recycled. Applies to recyclable packaging with or without deposit.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingShape.label: Packaging Shape
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingShape.definition: A code depicting the shape of a package for example CONE.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/pantothenicAcidP.label: Pantothenic Acid Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/pantothenicAcidP.definition: Pantothenic Acid per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/parentOrganizati.label: Parent Organization
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/parentOrganizati.definition: Designates the legal entity or function directly above the organisation/party being identified in a hierarchy. This is not defaulted to the highest-level entity in the hierarchy. Only one parent organisation SHALL be associated to a single GLN. To specify other affiliated organisations, see gs1:affiliatedTo, gs1:managedBy, gs1:franchiseeOf, gs1:ownedBy. To specify an organisation/party lower in the hierarchy, see gs1:subOrganization.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/paymentLink.label: Make Payment
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/paymentLink.definition: A link to a place where payments details are provided and/or payments can be made by the user.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/phosphorusPerNut.label: Phosphorus Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/phosphorusPerNut.definition: Phosphorus per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/pip.label: Product Information Page
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/pip.definition: A link to information specifically about the identified item, typically operated by the brand owner or a retailer of the product and aimed at consumers. It may include links to further information, product description, specifications etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polyolsPerNutrie.label: Polyols Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polyolsPerNutrie.definition: Polyols per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polyunsaturatedF.label: Polyunsaturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polyunsaturatedF.definition: Polyunsaturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/potassiumPerNutr.label: Potassium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/potassiumPerNutr.definition: Potassium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationCode.label: Preparation Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationCode.definition: Code specifying the preparation state of the product for which the nutrient information is valid. PREPARED, UNPREPARED.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationInfor.label: Has Food And Beverage Preparation Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationInfor.definition: Links to information about how to prepare a specific Food/Beverage/Tobacco product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preservationTech.label: Preservation Technique
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preservationTech.definition: Code indicating the preservation technique used to preserve the product from deterioration, for example, BRINING.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/priceSpecificati.label: Price Specification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/priceSpecificati.definition: The price related to an offer. If the offer is a multi-buy offer for a quantity of product greater than one unit, this should be indicated using the property gs1:eligibleQuantity

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/primaryAlternate.label: Has Primary Alternate Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/primaryAlternate.definition: A product that is similar to the current product but is not exact match. Same form fit function, e.g. same product different colour, different package size, better quality.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/primaryLocationO.label: Primary location of
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/primaryLocationO.definition: Links to the organisation(s) that designate this place as its/their primary location. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productSustainab.label: Sustainability and recycling (deprecated)
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productSustainab.definition: This term has been deprecated. Please use gs1:sustainabilityInfo instead.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYield.label: Product Yield
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYield.definition: Product quantity after preparation. This can differ based on productYieldType

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYieldType.label: Product Yield Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYieldType.definition: Code indicating the type of yield measurement specified in productYield. Examples: AFTER_DILUTION, DRAINED_WEIGHT.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionDate.label: Production Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionDate.definition: The production date is the production or assembly date determined by the manufacturer. The date may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionDateTi.label: Production Date and Time
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionDateTi.definition: The date and time of production (or assembly). The date and time of production is determined by the manufacturer. The date and time may refer to the trade item itself or to the items contained.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/proteinPerNutrie.label: Protein Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/proteinPerNutrie.definition: Protein per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/purchaseSupplies.label: Purchase supplies or accessories
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/purchaseSupplies.definition: A link to information about where supplies or accessories for the item can be purchased or ordered.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/quickStartGuide.label: Quick start guide
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/quickStartGuide.definition: A link to a description of the key features needed to be understood to begin using the item or interacting with something new.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/recallStatus.label: Recall status
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/recallStatus.definition: A link to information about whether the product has been recalled or not, typically an API.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/recipeInfo.label: Recipe website
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/recipeInfo.definition: A link to a recipe website.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFile.label: Has Referenced File
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFile.definition: Link to a file or website containing additional information on product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileSi.label: Referenced File Size
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileSi.definition: The size of the file as it is stored in an uncompressed format.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileTy.label: Referenced File Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileTy.definition: A code indicating the purpose or role of file (not a MIME type) that is being referenced, for example PRODUCT_LABEL_IMAGE. This code is used when the purpose of a file is not specified in the property.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/registerProduct.label: Register purchase
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/registerProduct.definition: A link to an entry point for registering ownership of a product including for warranty purposes.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/registryEntry.label: Entry in a register
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/registryEntry.definition: A link to an entry in a register, such as a business register or register of locations. Such registers may act as alternative identifiers, such as official company numbers, LEIs, other location identifiers etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulationType.label: Regulation Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulationType.definition: Links to a code indicating the type of government regulation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryIdenti.label: Regulatory Identifier
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryIdenti.definition: Links to one or more groupings of identifiers that reference documents or datasets within a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryIdenti.label: Regulatory Identifier Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryIdenti.definition: The code indicating the type of regulatory information that is referenced.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryInform.label: Regulatory Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryInform.definition: Links to one or more groupings of information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryInform.label: Regulatory Information Provider
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryInform.definition: The organisation that provided a document or dataset to a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/reheatingClaim.label: Reheating Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/reheatingClaim.definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging whether a food product which is ready to eat can be reheated if required prior to consumption.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedImage.label: Related image
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedImage.definition: A link to any image that depicts or relates to the identified entity (e.g., trade item, assets, business process, patient record, location, organisation, etc.)

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedOrganizat.label: Has Organisation
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedOrganizat.definition: The organisation(s) associated with a place.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedVideo.label: Related  video
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedVideo.definition: A link to any video, or document that has an embedded video, that describes or relates to the identified item, organisation, or location in some way.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByOrgani.label: Replaced by organization
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByOrgani.definition: Links to the successor organisation that is used in place of a previous organisation

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByPlace.label: Replaced by Place
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByPlace.definition: Links to the successor location that is used in place of a previous location

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByProduc.label: Has Replaced By Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByProduc.definition: The product which permanently replaces the current product. This product is sent in the record for the original item that is being replaced.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedOrganiza.label: Replaced organization
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedOrganiza.definition: Links to the previous organisation that this organisation replaces

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedPlace.label: Replaced Place
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedPlace.definition: Links to the previous location that this location replaces

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedProduct.label: Has Replaced Product
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedProduct.definition: Indicates the product identification of an item that is being permanently replaced by this product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/reportFound.label: Report  found
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/reportFound.definition: A link to a platform or service where users (company or a person) can report a found item associated with the identified entity (instance of an item). This link type is designed to assist in connecting the found item with its rightful owner or relevant authorities.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibleForLo.label: Responsible for location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibleForLo.definition: Links to the place(s) for which this organisation is responsible.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibleOrgan.label: Organisation responsible for the location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibleOrgan.definition: Links to the organisation that is directly responsible for this place.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/returnablePackag.label: Returnable Package Deposit Amount
