https://ref.gs1.org/voc/returnablePackag.definition: The monetary amount for the individual returnable package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/returnablePackag.label: Returnable Package Deposit Region
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/returnablePackag.definition: The geographic region associated with the returnable package deposit amount.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/riboflavinPerNut.label: Riboflavin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/riboflavinPerNut.definition: Riboflavin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/saltPerNutrientB.label: Salt Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/saltPerNutrientB.definition: Salt per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/saturatedFatPerN.label: Saturated Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/saturatedFatPerN.definition: Saturated fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/scheduleTime.label: Scheduling/Reservation
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/scheduleTime.definition: A link to a site that offers information on scheduling, appointments, or reservations. This may or may not allow the user to book the reservation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonParameter.label: Season Parameter
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonParameter.definition: Code indicating the season in which the product is available, e.g. SPRING, WINTER

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seleniumPerNutri.label: Selenium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seleniumPerNutri.definition: Selenium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sellByDate.label: Sell By Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sellByDate.definition: The date specified by the manufacturer as the last date the retailer is to offer the product for sale to the consumer. The product should not be merchandised after this date.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seller.label: Seller
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seller.definition: The organization seeking to sell a product or service.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/serviceInfo.label: Service information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/serviceInfo.definition: A link to service or maintenance instructions.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSize.label: Serving Size
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSize.definition: Measurement value specifying the serving size in which the information per nutrient has been stated. Example: Per 100 GRM.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sharpnessOfChees.label: Sharpness Of Cheese
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sharpnessOfChees.definition: The descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the sharpness of the taste of the product for example EXTRA_SHARP. Usually the longer the aging of the product, the sharper the taste.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/size.label: Size
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/size.definition: Links a wearable product to one or more groupings of gs1:SizeDetails representing size systems, size groups, size type and size dimensions.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCode.label: Size Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCode.definition: Links a product to one or more groupings of gs1:SizeCodeDetails representing the size value from a specified code list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeDimension.label: Size Dimension
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeDimension.definition: The numerical size measurement relating to the size type.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeGroup.label: Size Group
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeGroup.definition: Code indicating the type of size that is necessary to uniquely specify the size of the item, for example, BOYS.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeSystem.label: Size System
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeSystem.definition: The system that is being used to define the size for example EUROPE. Size system is used in conjunction with size group to define the size dimension.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeType.label: Size Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeType.definition: The type of size dimension being specified for example SLEEVE.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/smartLabel.label: SmartLabel
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/smartLabel.definition: A link to the product's SmartLabel page.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/smpc.label: Summary Product Characteristics (SmPC)
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/smpc.definition: A link to Summary Product Characteristics. To be used specifically when linking to information for healthcare professionals.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/socialMedia.label: Social media
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/socialMedia.definition: A link to a social media channel. The title will typically be replaced by the name of the channel.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sodiumPerNutrien.label: Sodium Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sodiumPerNutrien.definition: Sodium per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sourceAnimal.label: Source Animal Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sourceAnimal.definition: Code indicating the source of raw material used to produce the food product, for example a GOAT for milk.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sportingActivity.label: Sporting Activity Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sportingActivity.definition: Code indicating the type of sporting activity for which the product is intended to be worn, for example FOOTBALL.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/starchPerNutrien.label: Starch Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/starchPerNutrien.definition: Starch per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/statisticInfo.label: Statistics
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/statisticInfo.definition: A link to information about statistics regarding an organisation, location, or other entity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subOrganization.label: Sub-Organization
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subOrganization.definition: Designates a legal entity or function directly below the organisation/party being identified in a hierarchy. There may be multiple sub-organisations associated to a single GLN. To specify other affiliated organisations, see gs1:manages, gs1:franchisorOf, gs1:owns. To specify a parent organisation, see gs1:parentOrganization.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subscribe.label: Subscribe
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subscribe.definition: A link to a subscription form

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sugarsPerNutrien.label: Sugars Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sugarsPerNutrien.definition: Sugars per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/support.label: Support
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/support.definition: A link to a source of support such as a helpdesk, chat support, email etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sustainabilityIn.label: Sustainability and recycling
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sustainabilityIn.definition: A link to information relating to sustainability and recycling requirements or processes.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sweetnessLevelOf.label: Sweetness level of alcoholic beverage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sweetnessLevelOf.definition: Indicates the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify the sweetness of the alcoholic beverage. These are sometimes placed on a label. In some markets, the term is based on the amount of sugar content according to local regulation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetConsumerGe.label: Target Consumer Gender
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetConsumerGe.definition: Identifies the target consumer gender for which a product has been designed for example MALE

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetMarket.label: Has Target Market
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetMarket.definition: Relates to a set of target market details (product release date and associated countries)

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetMarketCoun.label: Target Market Countries
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetMarketCoun.definition: List of countries representing the target market for a particular release date indicated by gs1:consumerFirstAvailabilityDateTime

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterial.label: Has Textile Material
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterial.definition: One or more links to information about the materials used in a wearable product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialW.label: Textile Material Weight
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialW.definition: The measured weight of the material expressed in ounces per square yard or grams per square meter.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/thiaminPerNutrie.label: Thiamin Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/thiaminPerNutrie.definition: Thiamin per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/traceability.label: Traceability information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/traceability.definition: A link to traceability information (includes track and trace). Traceability information may be provided for consumption by humans or computers. If the target is an EPCIS repository, use gs1:epcis instead.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transFatPerNutri.label: Trans Fat Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transFatPerNutri.definition: Trans Fat per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionType.label: Transaction Reference
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionType.definition: The code indicating the type of business transactions

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/tutorial.label: Tutorial
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/tutorial.definition: A link to a tutorial or set of tutorials, such as online classes, how-to videos etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/upperMaterialTyp.label: Has Upper Material
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/upperMaterialTyp.definition: The material(s) used for the upper part of the footwear product. The upper is the part of a shoe, boot, slipper or other item of footwear that is above the sole.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/userAgreement.label: Sign waiver/agreement/document
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/userAgreement.definition: A link to an agreement or waiver.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/usesManagedLocat.label: Uses managed location
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/usesManagedLocat.definition: Links to the place(s) that this organisation uses as a managed space.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/verificationServ.label: Verification Service
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/verificationServ.definition: A link to a GS1 Lightweight Messaging Service for verifying the status of a product, organisation, or location and its identifier.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminAPerNutri.label: Vitamin A Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminAPerNutri.definition: Vitamin A per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminB12PerNut.label: Vitamin B12 Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminB12PerNut.definition: Vitamin B12 per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminB6PerNutr.label: Vitamin B6 Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminB6PerNutr.definition: Vitamin B6 per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminCPerNutri.label: Vitamin C Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminCPerNutri.definition: Vitamin C per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminDPerNutri.label: Vitamin D Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminDPerNutri.definition: Vitamin D per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminEPerNutri.label: Vitamin E Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminEPerNutri.definition: Vitamin E per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminKPerNutri.label: Vitamin K Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vitaminKPerNutri.definition: Vitamin K per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warranty.label: Has Offer Warranty
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warranty.definition: The warranty associated with the product, as provided by the manufacturer.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/whatsInTheBox.label: What's in the box?
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/whatsInTheBox.definition: A link to a description of all the individual items in a packaged item.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/zincPerNutrientB.label: Zinc Per Nutrient Basis Quantity
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/zincPerNutrientB.definition: Zinc per specified nutrient basis quantity.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalOrgani.label: Additional Organization Identification Type Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalOrgani.definition: The value associated with the Additional Organization Identification Type Value.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.label: Additional Product Classification Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.definition: Code specifying the applied additional product classification scheme.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.label: Additional Product Classification Code Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.definition: A description related to the additional product classification code value.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.label: Additional Product Classification Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.definition: Code specifying an additional product classification other than the GS1 Global Product Classification. The applied classification scheme is specified as additional information together with the classification value.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.label: Additional Product Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalProduc.definition: Additional variants necessary to communicate to the industry to help define the product. Multiple variants can be established for each GTIN for e.g. Style, Colour, and Fragrance .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additiveName.label: Additive Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additiveName.definition: The name of any additive or genetic modification contained or not contained in the product .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressLocality.label: Address Locality
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressLocality.definition: Text specifying the name of the locality, for example a city.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressRegion.label: Province State Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressRegion.definition: Text specifying a province or state in abbreviated format for example NJ.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressSuburb.label: Address Suburb
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/addressSuburb.definition: A suburb within a town or city.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/alcoholicBeverag.label: Alcoholic Beverage Sub-region
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/alcoholicBeverag.definition: A legally defined geographical region where the grapes for a wine were grown also known as an appellation. It is recommended to populate this property with an ISO 3166-2 code to indicate country and subdivision.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenSpecific.label: Allergen Specification Agency
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenSpecific.definition: The agency or other organization that defines or manages the criteria for allergen containment.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenSpecific.label: Allergen Specification Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenSpecific.definition: Free text field containing the name and version of the regulation or standard that defines the criteria of allergen containment.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenStatemen.label: Allergen Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/allergenStatemen.definition: Textual description of the presence or absence of allergens as governed by local rules and regulations, specified as one string.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableTo.label: Applicable to
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/applicableTo.definition: A property linking a gs1:linkType to the primary GS1 key(s) for which it can be used. Similar to rdfs:Domain but the value space is a GS1 Application Identifier, not a class.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.label: Authenticity Security Feature Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.definition: Provides human-readable instructions about how to locate a physical security marking and read a value from it.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.label: Authenticity Security Feature Regular Expression
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.definition: Links to a regular expression to be used to perform syntax validation (plausibility checking) of a string value read from a physical security marking.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.label: Authenticity Security Feature Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/authenticitySecu.definition: Links to a string value read from a physical security marking.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityEnds.label: Availability Ends
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityEnds.definition: The date from which the product is no longer available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityStar.label: Availability Starts
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availabilityStar.definition: The date from which the product is available from the information provider, including seasonal or temporary product and services.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availableLanguag.label: Available Language
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/availableLanguag.definition: ISO 639-1 code specifying the language of a specified contact point.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeCode.label: Award Prize Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeCode.definition: Indicates the achievement of the product in relation to a prize or award, e.g. winner, runner-up, shortlisted.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeDescri.label: Award Prize Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeDescri.definition: Text that describes the awards won.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeJury.label: Award Prize Jury
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeJury.definition: Free text listing members of the jury that awarded the prize.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeName.label: Award Prize Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeName.definition: The name of a prize or award which the product has received.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeYear.label: Award Prize Year
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/awardPrizeYear.definition: The year in which a prize or award was given.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/beverageVintage.label: Beverage Vintage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/beverageVintage.definition: The year in which the majority of ingredients are harvested and/or the alcoholic beverage is produced. Determination as to whether the vintage year is the harvest date or production date is according to requirements in the Target Market.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandName.label: Brand Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/brandName.definition: The brand name of the product that appears on the consumer package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/catchZone.label: Catch Zone
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/catchZone.definition: Free text field describing the sea zone from which the product was caught in.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAge.label: Certification Agency
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAge.definition: Name of the organisation issuing the certification standard or other requirement being met .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAud.label: Certification Audit Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationAud.definition: Date of completion of the auditing needed for certification

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationEnd.label: Certification End Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationEnd.definition: Last date of validity for the certification. (After this date the certification lapses and would need to be renewed/replaced)

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationIde.label: Certification Identification
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationIde.definition: A reference (i.e, to a certificate instance) issued to confirm that a product, party or location has passed certification. e.g. 'XSC-C-12345'

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.label: Certification Standard
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.definition: Name of the certification standard. Free text. Example: 'Egg classification' .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.label: Certification Start Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.definition: First date of validity for the certification

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.label: Certification Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationSta.definition: Certification scope statement of the individual certification instance. The same certificationStandard can be issued with different values of certificationStatement in different instances.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationURI.label: Certification URI
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/certificationURI.definition: If gs1:certificationURI is present, it should point to data about this individual certificate within a repository maintained by the certification agency.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cheeseMaturation.label: Cheese Maturation Period Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/cheeseMaturation.definition: A descriptive way to specify a date range as some cheeses are matured over a period of time, but not an exact period. For example 3 to 4 weeks, over 1 year etc. The term maturation is also known in other markets as Aged.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/circle.label: Circle
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/circle.definition: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centred at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/clothingCut.label: Clothing Cut
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/clothingCut.definition: Supplemental information to indicate the clothing cut or silhouette make of the garment. For example, silhouette details for a pair of jeans such as boot cut, or loose fit, comfort fit.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/collarType.label: Collar Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/collarType.definition: A free text description of the type of collar on the garment.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCodeValue.label: Colour Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourCodeValue.definition: A code indicating the colour of an object according to a specific code list. The applied code list is specified as additional information together with the colour code.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourDescriptio.label: Colour Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/colourDescriptio.definition: A description of the colour of an object.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/companyFilingURL.label: Company Filing URL
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/companyFilingURL.definition: A URI value linking to information related to organisation filing details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerFirstAva.label: Consumer First Availability Date Time
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerFirstAva.definition: The first date/time that the buyer is allowed to sell the product to consumers. Usually related to a specific geography. ISO 8601 date format CCYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerPackageD.label: Consumer Package Disclaimer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerPackageD.definition: Additional information that should be used in advertising and in displaying.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerRecyclin.label: Consumer Recycling Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerRecyclin.definition: Expresses in text the consumer recycling instructions which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. Instructions may refer to the 'how' the consumer is supposed to sort the product and packaging materials for recycling.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerSafetyIn.label: Consumer Safety Information
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerSafetyIn.definition: Information on consumer safety regarding the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerStorageI.label: Consumer Storage Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerStorageI.definition: Expresses in text the consumer storage instructions of a product which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerUsageIns.label: Consumer Usage Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/consumerUsageIns.definition: Free text containing the usage instructions of a product, which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactTitle.label: Contact Title
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactTitle.definition: The job title of the person that can be contacted for example Manager.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactType.label: Contact Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/contactType.definition: The function or role of a contact for example Customer Support.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/convenienceLevel.label: Convenience Level Percent
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/convenienceLevel.definition: An indication of the ease of preparation for semi-prepared products. The convenience level indicates the level of preparation in percentage required to prepare and helps the consumer to assess how long it will take to prepare the meal.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/coordinateRefere.label: Coordinate Reference System
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/coordinateRefere.definition: Open standard spatial reference systems or coordinate reference systems that provide coordinate-based local, regional or global system used to locate geographical entities. Values should be URIs already defined by the IOPG Geomatics Committee (https://epsg.org/), such as https://epsg.io/4326 (WGS84); https://epsg.io/4267 (NAD27); https://epsg.io/4230 (ED50); https://epsg.io/4618 (SAD69); https://epsg.io/4269 (NAD83). For elevation values, gs1:elevation SHALL be used.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryCode.label: Country Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryCode.definition: A short text string code (see values defined in ISO 3166) specifying the country in which a processing or other activity is performed, for example processing, bottling, manufacturing.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfOriginS.label: Country Of Origin Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countryOfOriginS.definition: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countrySubdivisi.label: Country Subdivision Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countrySubdivisi.definition: A short text string code (see values defined in ISO 3166_2) specifying the country subdivision in which an activity is performed, for example processing, bottling, manufacturing.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countyCode.label: County Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/countyCode.definition: A code that identifies a county. A county is a territorial division in some countries, forming the chief unit of local administration. In the US, a county is a political and administrative division of a state.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/crossStreet.label: Cross Street
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/crossStreet.definition: A street intersecting a main street (usually at right angles) and continuing on both sides of it.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/csrAffiliation.label: Corporate Social Responsibility Affiliation
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/csrAffiliation.definition: A URI value linking to information related to social responsibility activities and associations that an organisation/party is involved with.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dailyValueIntake.label: Daily Value Intake Percent
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dailyValueIntake.definition: The percentage of the recommended daily intake of a nutrient as recommended by authorities of the target market. Is expressed relative to the serving size and base daily value intake.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/department.label: Department
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/department.definition: The name of a division of an organization dealing with a specific activity

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/descriptiveSize.label: Descriptive Size
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/descriptiveSize.definition: An alphanumeric size factor the brand owner wishes to communicate to the consumer. IE Jumbo, Capri, Full Length, Maxi.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietCode.label: Diet Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietCode.definition: Links to multiple pairs of gs1:DietTypeCode and diet type sub code (free-form text string).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietTypeDescript.label: Diet Type Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietTypeDescript.definition: Free text for indication of diet not stated in the list of diets.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietTypeSubcode.label: Diet Type Sub-code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dietTypeSubcode.definition: Indicates a set of agreements or a certificate name that guarantees the product is permitted in a particular diet. A diet type subcode is a subclassification of a specific diet type. For example, Pareve is a diet type subcode of Kosher.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalAddress.label: Has Digital Address
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalAddress.definition: The location reference associated to a digital place. If gs1:glnType is present, SHALL only be associated if the value of gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-DIGITAL_LOCATION.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalLocationN.label: Digital Location Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalLocationN.definition: The name of a digital place. To specify the name of a physical location, see gs1:physicalLocationName.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/discountRepeatsP.label: Discount Repeats Per Multiple Minimum
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/discountRepeatsP.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount is available for each time the minimum qualifying criteria are met. This can be used to express '$10 off each $50 spend', which is distinct from a 20% discount because it is quantized in units of spending.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/discountType.label: Discount Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/discountType.definition: A code that specifies the type of payment discount applicable to an offer, for example BOGO.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxAmount.label: Duty Fee Tax Amount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxAmount.definition: The current tax or duty or fee amount applicable to the product, expressed as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxDescri.label: Duty Fee Tax Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxDescri.definition: A description of tax type for example Taxes sure les supports audio.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxRate.label: Duty Fee Tax Rate
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/dutyFeeTaxRate.definition: The current tax or duty rate percentage applicable to the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/elevation.label: Elevation
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/elevation.definition: The elevation of a location (WGS 84). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNITOFMEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone SHALL be a value in meters.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleTradeCha.label: Eligible Trade Channel
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/eligibleTradeCha.definition: A code determining the location where a user can redeem the offer, for example ONLINE_ONLY.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/email.label: E-mail
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/email.definition: Creating/sending/receiving of unstructured free text messages or documents using computer network, a mini-computer or an attached modem and regular telephone line or other electronic transmission media.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exactDiscountAmo.label: Exact Discount Amount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exactDiscountAmo.definition: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the exact discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '$10 off'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exactDiscountPer.label: Exact Discount Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/exactDiscountPer.definition: A floating-point value indicating an exact percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express '15% discount'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatInMilkContent.label: Fat In Milk Content
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatInMilkContent.definition: The percentage of fat contained in milk content of the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatpercentageInD.label: Fat In Dry Matter
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fatpercentageInD.definition: The amount of fat contained in the base product expressed in percentage.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/faxNumber.label: Telefax
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/faxNumber.definition: A fax number used for transmitting and reproducing fixed graphic material over telephone lines or other electronic transmission media.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fileLanguageCode.label: File Language Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fileLanguageCode.definition: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/filePixelHeight.label: File Pixel Height
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/filePixelHeight.definition: The number of pixels along the vertical axis of the image.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/filePixelWidth.label: File Pixel Width
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/filePixelWidth.definition: The number of pixels along the horizontal axis of the image.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fishType.label: Fish Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/fishType.definition: The type of fish for example Sea bass.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/functionalName.label: Functional Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/functionalName.definition: Describes use of the product or service by the consumer. Should help clarify the product classification associated with the GTIN.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/globalLocationNu.label: Global Location Number (GLN)
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/globalLocationNu.definition: A Global Location Number (GLN) is the GS1 Identification Key used to identify physical locations or parties. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix, Location Reference and Check Digit. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gln.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gpcCategoryCode.label: GPC Category Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gpcCategoryCode.definition: 8-digit code (GPC Brick Value) specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gpc

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gpcCategoryDescr.label: GPC Category Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gpcCategoryDescr.definition: A description of the code specifying a product category according to the GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) standard.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gtin.label: GTIN
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/gtin.definition: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin for more details.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/healthClaimDescr.label: Health Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/healthClaimDescr.definition: A description of health claims according to regulations of the target market.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/includedAccessor.label: Included Accessories
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/includedAccessor.definition: Any included object or device not part of the core product itself but which adds to its functionality or use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientConten.label: Ingredient Content Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientConten.definition: Quantity of the ingredient contained in the product as a percentage of the total product ingredients. This is used in conjunction with ingredientName.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientName.label: Ingredient Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientName.definition: Free text field describing an ingredient or ingredient group. Ingredients include any additives (colourings, preservatives, e-numbers, etc.) that are encompassed.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientOfConc.label: Ingredient of Concern
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientOfConc.definition: Indicates a claim to an ingredient, considered to be a concern for regulatory or other reasons, and which is 'contained' within the product but may not need to specify the amount whether approximate, or an accurate measurement be given.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientSequen.label: Ingredient Sequence
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientSequen.definition: Integer (1, 2, 3...) indicating the ingredient order by content percentage of the product. (major ingredient = 1, second ingredient = 2) etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientStatem.label: Ingredient Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/ingredientStatem.definition: Information on the constituent ingredient make up of the product specified as one string.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/initialCertifica.label: Initial Certification Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/initialCertifica.definition: The date when the certification was originally issued. May differ from the certificationStartDate of the current recertification cycle.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyAvailableT.label: Only Available Through Retailer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyAvailableT.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available through the retailer making the offer.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithMailin.label: Only For Retailer Mailing List Members
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithMailin.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for customers who have signed up to the retailer's mailing list.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithPaymen.label: Only With Payment Card
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithPaymen.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing using one of the specified payment card types.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithRetail.label: Only For Retailer Loyalty Cardholders
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithRetail.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own loyalty card.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithRetail.label: Only For Retailer Payment Cardholders
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isOnlyWithRetail.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount is only available for holders of the retailer's own store payment card.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isProductRecalle.label: Is Product Recalled
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isProductRecalle.definition: An indicator for the product to determine if the Manufacturer or Supplier has recalled the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPromoterExclus.label: Is Promoter Exclusive Offer
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/isPromoterExclus.definition: Determines whether the offer is only provided by the promoter

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/juiceContentPerc.label: Juice Content Percent
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/juiceContentPerc.definition: The fruit juice content of the product expressed as a percentage.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/latitude.label: Latitude
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/latitude.definition: Angular distance North or South from the earth's equator measured through 90 degrees.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/line.label: Line
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/line.definition: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more point objects separated by a space. A single line segment (i.e., straight line) is expressed as two points. A multi-line path (i.e., open polygon) is expressed as a series of three or more points. For a closed shape, gs1:polygon SHALL be used.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationFinalClo.label: Location Final Closure Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationFinalClo.definition: Date in which a location was finally closed. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was deactivated. To designate when location opened, see gs1:locationOpeningDate.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationGLN.label: Location GLN
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationGLN.definition: 13-digit GLN that is being used to identify a physical or digital location. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:locationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:GLN_TypeCode includes FIXED_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, or DIGITAL_LOCATION

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID.label: Location ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID.definition: Identifier value associated to a location. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the administrating organisation designated in gs1:LocationID_Type.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_Quali.label: Location ID Qualifier
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationID_Quali.definition: Secondary qualifier to supplement gs1:LocationID_Type meaning. May be used with proprietary ID code values to define identifier administrator.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationOpeningD.label: Location Opening Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationOpeningD.definition: Date in which a location was opened or otherwise established. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was allocated to identify the location. To designate when location was finally closed, see gs1: gs1:locationFinalClosureDate

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/longitude.label: Longitude
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/longitude.definition: The arc or portion of the earth's equator intersected between the meridian of a given place and the prime meridian and expressed in degrees

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maxPrice.label: Maximum Price
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maxPrice.definition: Provides a maximum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumDiscountA.label: Maximum Discount Amount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumDiscountA.definition: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to $10 off'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumDiscountP.label: Maximum Discount Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumDiscountP.definition: A floating-point value indicating a maximum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'up to 15% discount'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumQualifyin.label: Maximum Qualifying Items
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumQualifyin.definition: Specifies the maximum number of items that qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'maximum N items per customer'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumQualifyin.label: Maximum Qualifying Spend
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/maximumQualifyin.definition: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the maximum spend that qualifies for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'for purchases of up to $100'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/meatPoultryType.label: Meat Poultry Type Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/meatPoultryType.definition: The fish, meat, or poultry type for this food and beverage item.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minPrice.label: Minimum Price
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minPrice.definition: Provides a minimum price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumDiscountA.label: Minimum Discount Amount
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumDiscountA.definition: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least $10 off'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumDiscountP.label: Minimum Discount Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumDiscountP.definition: A floating-point value indicating a minimum percentage discount on the sales price associated with a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'at least 15% discount'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumQualifyin.label: Minimum Qualifying Items
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumQualifyin.definition: Specifies the minimum number of items that must be purchased to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you buy at least N items'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumQualifyin.label: Minimum Qualifying Spend
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/minimumQualifyin.definition: Links to a gs1:PriceSpecification that indicates in terms of an amount and specified currency, the minimum spend required to qualify for a particular gs1:Discount. This property can be used to express 'if you spend at least $100'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.label: Number of Servings Per Package
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.definition: The total number of servings contained in the package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.label: Number of Servings Range Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/numberOfServings.definition: A free text field specifying a range for the number of servings contained in the package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutritionalClaim.label: Nutritional Claim Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/nutritionalClaim.definition: Free text field for any additional nutritional claims.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDescription.label: Offer Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerDescription.definition: A description of the offer including goods or services offered for sale or use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRedemptionT.label: Offer Redemption Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRedemptionT.definition: A code indicating the type of redemptions that apply to the offer, for example single use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRestriction.label: Offer Restriction Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/offerRestriction.definition: A description of what the offer is restricted to, relative to all other offerings by the issuer, for example payment restrictions, subscription required, new customers only.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicPercentCl.label: Organic Percent Claim
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organicPercentCl.definition: The percent of actual organic materials per weight of the product. This is usually claimed on the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.label: Organization Classification ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.definition: Classification value that is administered by an organisation. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the system indicated by the code value of gs1:organizationClassificationType.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.label: Organization Classification Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationClas.definition: Classification system name associated with gs1:organizationClassificationID.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationForm.label: Organisation Formation Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationForm.definition: Date in which an organisation was formed or otherwise established. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was allocated to identify the organisation. To designate when organisation was terminated, see gs1:organizationTerminationDate

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID.label: Organisation ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID.definition: Identifier value associated to an organisation/party. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the administrating organisation designated in gs1:OrganizationID_Type.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_Q.label: Organisation ID Qualifier
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationID_Q.definition: Secondary qualifier to supplement gs1:organizationID_Type meaning. May be used with proprietary ID code values to define identifier administrator.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationLega.label: Organization Legal Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationLega.definition: The legal name used by an organisation for official purposes. There may be more than one legal name, particularly in countries with more than one official language. In such cases the language of the string should be identified. To specify a general name, see gs1:organizationName. For trade name, see gs1:organizationTradingName. To specify the name of a function, see gs1:department.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationName.label: Organization Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationName.definition: The name of the organization expressed in text.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationTerm.label: Organisation Termination Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationTerm.definition: Date in which an organisation was disbanded or otherwise ended. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was deactivated. To designate when organisation formed, see gs1:organizationFormationDate.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationTrad.label: Organization Trading Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/organizationTrad.definition: A trading name or alternative forms of a legal entity's name as recognised by some jurisdictions. To specify a general name, see gs1:organizationName. For legal name, see gs1:organizationLegalName. To specify the name of a function, see gs1:department.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/originalCodeValu.label: Original Code Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/originalCodeValu.definition: Links to the alphanumeric code value defined elsewhere in GS1 or the GS1 Global Data Dictionary

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingType.label: Packaging Type
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/packagingType.definition: The dominant means used to transport, store, handle or display the product as defined by the data source. This packaging is not used to describe any manufacturing process.Recommend to use UNECE Rec 21 codes.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/partyGLN.label: Party GLN
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/partyGLN.definition: 13-digit GLN that is being used to identify a legal entity or function. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:partyGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:GLN_TypeCode includes LEGAL_ENTITY and/or FUNCTION

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/paymentTerms.label: Payment Terms
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/paymentTerms.definition: The type of payment term expressed as a code, for example Discount.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/percentageOfAlco.label: Percentage of Alcohol Per Volume
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/percentageOfAlco.definition: The percentage of alcohol contained in product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/physicalLocation.label: Physical Location Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/physicalLocation.definition: The name of a physical place. To specify the name of a digital location, see gs1:digitalLocationName.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polygon.label: Polygon
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/polygon.definition: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postOfficeBoxNum.label: PO Box Number
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postOfficeBoxNum.definition: The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postalCode.label: Postal Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postalCode.definition: Text specifying the postal code for an address.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postalName.label: Postal Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/postalName.definition: The name of the recipient expressed in text. Note that this may be different than gs1:OrganizationName.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationConsu.label: Preparation Consumption Precautions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationConsu.definition: Specifies additional precautions to be taken before preparation or consumption of the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationInstr.label: Preparation Instructions
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/preparationInstr.definition: Free text providing instructions on how to prepare the product before serving.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/price.label: Price Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/price.definition: Provides a price value as a floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding currency. See also gs1:priceCurrency. The price value indicates the unit price unless the property gs1:eligibleQuantity is specified and indicates multiple units

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/priceCurrency.label: Price Currency
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/priceCurrency.definition: A string value indicating a currency from ISO 4217 for example USD .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productDescripti.label: Product Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productDescripti.definition: An understandable and useable description of a product using brand and other descriptors. This attribute is filled with as little abbreviation as possible, while keeping to a reasonable length. This should be a meaningful description of the product with full spelling to facilitate message processing. Retailers can use this description as the base to fully understand the brand, flavour, scent etc. of the specific product, in order to accurately create a product description as needed for their internal systems. Examples: XYZ Brand Base Invisible Solid Deodorant AP Stick Spring Breeze.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productFeatureBe.label: Product Feature Benefit
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productFeatureBe.definition: Element for consumer facing marketing content to describe the key features or benefits of the style suitable for display purposes.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productFormDescr.label: Product Form Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productFormDescr.definition: The physical form or shape of the product. Used, for example, in pharmaceutical industry to indicate the formulation of the product. Defines the form the product takes and is distinct from the form of the packaging.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productID.label: Product ID
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productID.definition: Additional means to the Global Trade Item Number to identify a product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productMarketing.label: Product Marketing Message
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productMarketing.definition: Marketing message associated with the product. Consumer-friendly marketing detailed description of the product.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productName.label: Product Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productName.definition: Consumer friendly short description of the product suitable for compact presentation.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productRange.label: Product Range
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productRange.definition: A name, used by a Brand Owner, that span multiple consumer categories or uses. E.g. (Waist Watchers).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYieldVari.label: Product Yield Variation Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productYieldVari.definition: Indication of range in percent of the given cooking / roasting loss. Percentage that the actual weight of the product differs upward or downward from the average or estimated product yield.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionVarian.label: Production Variant Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionVarian.definition: Free text assigned by the manufacturer to describe the production variant. Examples are: package series X, package series Y.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionVarian.label: Production Variant Effective Date Time
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/productionVarian.definition: The start date of a production variant. The variant applies to products having a date mark (a best before date or expiration date) on the package that comes on or after the effective date.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/provenanceStatem.label: Provenance Statement
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/provenanceStatem.definition: Free text description of the region or place the product originates from. This is to be specifically used to specify areas such as cities, mountain ranges, regions. Examples: Made in the Thuringen Mountains, Made in Paris, From the Napa Valley.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingBrandN.label: Qualifying Brand Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingBrandN.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the brand names specified via this property.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingGPCs.label: Qualifying Product GPC codes
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingGPCs.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose Global Product Classification (GPC) brick value appears in the list specified via this property.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.label: Qualifying Product Category Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from categories specified in this free-form text field.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.label: Qualifying Product Classification Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose product classification (other than GPC) appears in the list specified via this property. This property specifies a product classification other than GPC.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.label: Qualifying Product GTINs
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingProduc.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product whose GTIN appears in the list specified via this property.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingSubBra.label: Qualifying Sub-brand Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/qualifyingSubBra.definition: If specified, the discount is only available when purchasing a product from one of the sub-brand names (specified product ranges for a given brand) specified via this property.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileEf.label: Referenced File Effective End Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileEf.definition: The date upon which the target of this external link ceases to be effective for use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileEf.label: Referenced File Effective Start Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileEf.definition: The date upon which the target of this external link begins to be effective for use.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileUR.label: Website
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/referencedFileUR.definition: Simple text string that refers to a resource on the internet, URLs may refer to documents, resources, people, etc.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatedProduct.label: Regulated Product Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatedProduct.definition: The prescribed, regulated or generic product name or denomination that describes the true nature of the product. For example for a food product in order to distinguish it from other foods according to country specific regulations.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryAct.label: Regulatory Act
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryAct.definition: The name given to the requirement assigned by the regulatory agency.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.label: Regulatory Reference Applicability End Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.definition: The final date for which the referenced information remains applicable.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.label: Regulatory Reference Applicability Start Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.definition: The earliest date from which the referenced information becomes applicable.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.label: Regulatory Reference Number
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryRefere.definition: A reference number for a record, document or dataset stored within a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryVerifi.label: Regulatory Verification Number
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/regulatoryVerifi.definition: A verification number for a record, document or dataset stored within a regulatory information system, repository or registry, typically used in combination with the reference number when requesting access to the refrenced document or dataset.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibility.label: Responsibility
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibility.definition: Text further specifying the area of responsibility of the trade contact.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonCalendarYe.label: Season Calendar Year
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonCalendarYe.definition: The calendar year in which the product is seasonally available.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonName.label: Season Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/seasonName.definition: Element defines the season applicable to the item for example Winter.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/selectedProducts.label: Selected Products Only
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/selectedProducts.definition: If specified and set to true, the discount only applies to specific products selected by the retailer or offer promoter - not to all items in that product category. This property should be asserted and set to true for offers that say 'on selected products'.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSizeDescr.label: Serving Size Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSizeDescr.definition: A free text field specifying the serving size for which the nutrient information has been stated for example: per 1/3 cup (42 g).

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSuggestio.label: Serving Suggestion
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/servingSuggestio.definition: Free text field for serving suggestion.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/siteAccessRequir.label: Site Access Requirements
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/siteAccessRequir.definition: A URI value linking to information related to requirements for accessing or visiting a place.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCodeListCode.label: Size Code List Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCodeListCode.definition: Code specifying a size code list. Allowed code values are specified in GS1 Code List SizeCodeListCode .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCodeValue.label: Size Code
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/sizeCodeValue.definition: A code indicating the size of an object according to a specific code list. The applied code list is specified as additional information together with the size code.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/statusTimestamp.label: Status Timestamp
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/statusTimestamp.definition: Date and time (including optional timezone) associated to status designations. Timestamps may be future dated to provide advance notice of status changes. For further information about the required lexical representation of date, time, and timezone please see https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddress.label: Street Address
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddress.definition: The street address expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress SHOULD be used before populating lines two through four. For a PO Box gs1:postOfficeBoxNumber SHOULD be used instead.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.label: Street Address Line 2
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.definition: The second line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress SHOULD be used before populating lines two through four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.label: Street Address Line 3
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.definition: The third line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. A total of four street address lines are available. gs1:streetAddress and gs1:streetaddressLine2 SHOULD be used before populating lines three and four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.label: Street Address Line 4
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/streetAddressLin.definition: The fourth line of the street address, expressed as free form text. The street address is printed on paper as the first lines below the name. For example, the name of the street and the number in the street or the name of a building. gs1:streetAddress, gs1:streetaddressLine2 and gs1:streetaddressLine3 SHOULD be used before populating line four. These SHALL NOT be used as alternatives to the dedicated address properties gs1:addressSuburb, gs1:addressLocality and gs1:addressRegion.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/styleDescription.label: Style Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/styleDescription.definition: An attribute that classifies products that share many of the same characteristics (attribute values) that does NOT vary by GTIN, and are presented by the supplier as a single merchandise selection for the buyer.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subBrandName.label: Sub-brand Name
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/subBrandName.definition: Second level of brand. Can be a trademark. It is the primary differentiating factor that a brand owner wants to communicate to the consumer or buyer. E.g. Yummy-Cola Classic. In this example Yummy-Cola is the brand and Classic is the sub-brand.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/supplierSpecifie.label: Supplier Specified Minimum Consumer Storage Days
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/supplierSpecifie.definition: Represents the number of days between a product's sell by date and its use by date.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetConsumerAg.label: Target Consumer Age
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/targetConsumerAg.definition: Identifies the target consumer age range for which a product has been designed.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialC.label: Textile Material Content
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialC.definition: A description of the material composition used in conjunction with the material percentage.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialD.label: Textile Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialD.definition: This provides a name or brief description of one material contained within the product, for example Rayon.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialP.label: Textile Material Percentage
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialP.definition: Corresponding net weight percentage of the product material specified via gs1:textileMaterialDescription, e.g. 70.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialT.label: Textile Material Thread Count
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/textileMaterialT.definition: The quality of material (fabric) of a product based on the total number of vertical and horizontal threads in one square inch.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionDate.label: Transaction Date
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionDate.definition: The date associated with a business transaction

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionID.label: Transaction Reference
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/transactionID.definition: An identifier for a business transactions

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/unitCode.label: Measurement Unit
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/unitCode.definition: A string value indicating a Measurement Unit from UN/ECE Recommendation 20, Units of Measure used in International Trade e.g. GRM = gram - see http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/cefact/recommendations/rec20/rec20_rev3_Annex3e.pdf

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/validFrom.label: Valid From
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/validFrom.definition: The effective start date of the price .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/validThrough.label: Valid Through
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/validThrough.definition: The effective end date of the price .

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/value.label: Measurement Value
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/value.definition: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/variantDescripti.label: Variant Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/variantDescripti.definition: Free text field used to identify the variant of the product. Variants are the distinguishing characteristics that differentiate products with the same brand and size including such things as the particular flavour, fragrance, taste.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vintner.label: Vintner
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/vintner.definition: The person hired by a winery or wine company who is responsible for many of the processes in the preparation, taste and quality of the wine produced. The science of wine making is referred to as oenology. The vintner is the oenologist.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warningCopyDescr.label: Warning Copy Description
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warningCopyDescr.definition: Warning information is additional information that outlines special requirements, warning and caution information printed on the package.

https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warrantyScopeDes.label: Warranty Scope
https://ref.gs1.org/voc/warrantyScopeDes.definition: The description of warranty available for the product. Allows for the representation of the same value in different languages but not for multiple values.
